note:
Replaces skingenetix-faq-cream-jar-stack-2026-v3.jpg — the four-jar stack on a dark ground that faq-image-publish-4.json shipped — with a model shot of the Acetyl Hexapeptide-8 serum. Same slot, same section, no layout change.

HIS FILE, CHOSEN BY HIM, AND HIS MARK LEFT ALONE. The source carries a single leading underscore, which is Malcolm's keeper mark. It was read in place and neither renamed nor moved; the JPEG for upload was written to a separate publish-ready folder.

SQUARE MATCHES THE SLOT EXACTLY. The faq_section image renders 564x564 at 1440 — a true 1:1 box — and the source is 2048x2048, so there is no crop and no scaling distortion. The outgoing jar stack was also square, so nothing in the section reflows.

LABEL VERIFIED AT 100% BEFORE UPLOAD, counted as elements rather than spellchecked, because a label missing a line passes a read of the lines present. All six are there and correct:
  helix mark   the Skingenetix mark, compared side by side against the official
               Skingenetix-logo-black.png rather than eyeballed — S-curve, vertical ticks
               crossing it, scattered rounded dots. This store has shipped a wrong helix
               before on a frame whose wordmark was spelled perfectly, so the mark is checked
               as its own element.
  wordmark     Skingenetix
  product      ACETYL HEXAPEPTIDE-8
  descriptor   ANTI-WRINKLE SERUM
  tier         PREMIUM FORMULA
  fine line    10% ACETYL HEXAPEPTIDE-8 | 30ML — and 30ML is correct for a serum. Three serum
               cartons in the artwork set wrongly state 50ML; this bottle does not.

NOT A DUPLICATE ON THE PAGE, WHICH WAS CHECKED AND NOT ASSUMED. This exact frame is already on the CDN as skingenetix-review-acetyl-hexapeptide-8-model-2026.jpg, uploaded by reviews-rebuild.json for the homepage reviews row. That file is NO LONGER REFERENCED — the reviews section has since moved to the -v4/-v5 set — so nothing on the homepage shows it. The one live review image that could have collided, skingenetix-review-model-acetyl-hexapeptide-8-2026-v4.jpg, was fetched and compared: a different model, a different pose, no product in frame. So the FAQ slot and the reviews row do not show the same photograph.

A NEW FILENAME RATHER THAN REUSING THE EXISTING HANDLE, deliberately. Pointing the slot at skingenetix-review-acetyl-hexapeptide-8-model-2026.jpg would have avoided an upload, but that name describes a review slot it no longer fills and carries a bare year, which check_seo_name flags as worthless in an image search. The new stem leads with the product a shopper would type. Checked that it is not a prefix of any live file and that no live file is a prefix of it — the two closest are ...anti-wrinkle-serum-fine-lines and ...expression-lines-serum-applying-dropper, and neither prefixes this one — because the uploader binds by prefix while polling and this repo has twice bound two slots to the same image.

OPTIMISED, NOT COMPRESSED. 2048x2048 is already under the 3000px cap the theme's srcset tops out at, so it is uploaded at native size with EXIF and ICC stripped, quality 95 at 4:4:4. Re-encoding harder was measured on this store on 2026-08-24 and made pages marginally slower, because Shopify's CDN transcodes to WebP and reproducing JPEG artefacts costs bits.

THE OUTGOING FILE STAYS UPLOADED AND UNREFERENCED. skingenetix-faq-cream-jar-stack-2026-v3.jpg is not deleted — it cost three engines to produce (Seedream for the composition, gpt-image to fix MATRIXYL, NBP Flash to fix PDRN) and it is one command to put back.
